summary: Revision 1 complete. The window now wires the accepted design end to end: App.tsx computes the Files explorer root with explorerRoot (selected app root in the app view, the deepest owning app root of the active editor tab in the editor view, a Misc file's parent folder otherwise), passes it to the new ExplorerPanel in the Sidebar explorer slot with a reset key that discards temporary Up navigation, and opens explorer files through editor.openPath (the same editor_open_any path the picker uses). The sidebar renders with the Files section even with zero apps when a loose file applies, and the Home row only when apps exist. A new unconditional 'Open file…' command-palette action calls editor.openDialog, the same picker the toolbar Open… button, Ctrl+O and the empty-state 'Open a file…' button already use. The version moves to 2.2.0 in package.json, package-lock.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml, src-tauri/Cargo.lock and src-tauri/tauri.conf.json. Existing App suites gained an api/explorer mock (empty listing) and longer waits on lazy dialogs so their behaviour is pinned unchanged. Added App-level tests for R1/R3/R4/R5/A4, a Sidebar explorer test file for R2/A3/A4, and a version test for A2. Checks run and green: npm run lint, npm test (full), cargo test --test explorer, npm run build, rustfmt --check on new Rust files, cargo clippy --all-targets (0 warnings).
